description: 数据过滤配置文件 - 控制CKIN类型和Properties在筛选界面中的显示
description_en: Data filter configuration - Controls display of CKIN types and Properties in filtering interface
notes: 可根据需要添加或删除CKIN类型和Properties。修改后需要重新运行程序。
notes_en: Add or remove CKIN types and Properties as needed. Restart the application after making changes.
property_normalization_notes: Properties会自动标准化：去除数字和斜杠后缀（如INF1/0变为INF）
property_normalization_notes_en: Properties are automatically normalized: remove numeric and slash suffixes (e.g., INF1/0 becomes INF)
